system.description: Your fingers become ethereal, and you can press them into the forehead of a nearby creature to extract and erase their memory of all events within the last hour. The procedure is excruciating, but the creature will have no recollection of it. After, the subject will remain in a stupor for several minutes; during this time, they will be receptive to your explanation of recent events. Each spark doubles the duration of memory you steal.
